text: As I stand in the hallway outside a glass-walled conference room, I sense anticipation and restlessness. The clean lines of modern architecture and the emptiness beyond the transparent barrier evoke a feeling of potential. When I move closer to the vibrant R+D exhibition, curiosity surges within me. Surrounded by colorful displays, glowing screens, and words that hint at innovation and possibility, I feel invigorated. My mind is abuzz with ideas, and I feel connected to a broader, imaginative pursuit shared by others in this space.
